title: Improving Adherence
author: GGWXGhP7McKTXiTQc
chapter_outcomes: Describe types of non-adherence (failure to follow treatments and failure to attend appointments) and problems caused by non-adherence
Describe and evaluate explanations of why patients do not adhere; rational non-adherence, including a study, e.g. Laba et al. (2012); Health Belief Model
Describe and evaluate subjective measures including clinical interviews and semi-structured interviews, including a study, e.g. Riekert and Drotar (1999)
Describe and evaluate objective measures focusing on pill counting and medication dispensers, including a study, e.g. Chung and Naya (2000)
Describe and evaluate biological measures including blood and urine samples
Describe improving adherence in children including a study, e.g. Chaney et al. (2004)
Describe and evaluate individual behavioural techniques; contracts, prompts, customising treatment
Describe and evaluate community interventions (Key study: Yokley and Glenwick, 1984)
